errors.text_span: 逐渐上升至 x 轴上的 0.4 处的值 59.8%, 然后下降至 x 轴上的 0.6 处的值 58.8%
errors.evidence: This description of the central part of the line is incorrect. The line does not peak at x=0.4, but continues to rise to a peak at x=0.5 (with a value over 60.5%). The value at x=0.4 is approximately 59.3%, not 59.8%. The line then declines, but the value at x=0.6 is approximately 60.2%, not 58.8%. The description fabricates a peak at x=0.4 and misrepresents the subsequent trend and values.
The description fails to mention the most important feature of the graph: that the F1 value reaches a peak when λ is 0.5, with a value of approximately 60.5%.
